aboutText: At Northstar Garden & Maintenance Melbourne, we are dedicated to finishing each garden project on schedule and with the highest level of quality. With a focus on personalised service, competitive rates, and customer satisfaction, we always strive to meet and exceed expectations. Based in Preston, VIC, we genuinely believe that no job is too small, so call or email us today for a free onsite quote. We serve Preston and surrounding suburbs with professional gardening and maintenance.
servicesText: We offer a wide range of gardening and maintenance services tailored to Preston homes. From regular lawn care to complete garden makeovers, our team ensures your outdoor space thrives year-round. Contact us for customised service plans.
